decisions.summary: choices.json lists every registered knob, the declared choices and (amendment) every per-settlement roll of a form, with not_choices for the rest; the card lists each choice the map's meta records; a test scans the roll sites
decisions.why: Round 3: round 2's three required changes confirmed in the clone, 2026-10-05. (1) water_sink: hamletgen/sink.py stage_sink writes meta['water_sink'] = plan.water_sink AFTER lay_sink returns, so the value recorded is the final one after all three offmap fallbacks (the two that re-enter stage_sink and the one that re-enters lay_sink). (2) grain_drift: hamletgen/water/comb.py stage_field writes meta['grain_drift'] after the polder hand-off; polder.py reads none of grain_drift, intake or plot_size (grep), so the polder exemption in the test is the literal reading, not a carve-out. (3) The pool hamlets are regenerated: all five record water_sink (pond: Inashiro, Kuwabata, Mizuguchi; offmap: Kashikawa, Sawada), the four comb fields record grain_drift (-4, 4, 0, -4), grave_form where a grave is drawn (Inashiro island, Kashikawa corner); the manifests before f57a4a2ed carried neither key (git show), so the new meta test would have been red on them. Read every table key against the five metas: each is recorded wherever the map made that choice; the nulls are cluster_position and caravan_inn_form (never resolved in hamletgen/, grep), weir_form where no weir is drawn (Sawada open intake, Kuwabata polder), windbreak_belt on the two linear maps (no windbreak), and the comb-only keys on Kuwabata. The roll scan is '(?:_roll|knob_rng)\([\w.]*seed, "..."' over hamletgen/ and settlement/; every key it finds is in the table or not_choices, and the ten newly named not_choices (brook_approach, brook_wander, byre_share, passage_share, pit_field_share, house_bearing, head_offset, mulberry_fishpond, pond_stock, cremation_seat) are each geometry, a degree, a share, placement, or a roll no hamlet makes - none a choice of form (consistent with D10-not-choices). Rolls in other spellings (random.Random(self.seed * k ...) in castle_civic, compounds, trades, the torii counts; paddy_rest's f-string key) are counts at town tiers or a registered knob already in the table. test_every_choice_a_hamlet_rolls_reaches_its_map_s_meta does what round 2 required: every table key hamletgen/plan.py rolls or declares is checked against every pool hamlet's meta, gated by the entry's when. grave_form, rolled outside plan.py, is recorded exactly when a grave is drawn. The grove-sides sentence is off the hamlet card's facts (page.py; other tiers keep it under 'not hamlet', D10-other-tiers). make test-file FILE=tests/interactive/test_choices.py: 7 passed. With every choice a hamlet makes now on its meta, listing what meta records lists every choice the map made (US4-1, FR-009); the decision no longer drops anything.

decisions.summary: A knob that is a degree along a continuum (grain_drift, -12..12 by 4) takes one modal for the knob, its value shown as the card's label; every other key one modal per value
decisions.why: The GM asks that clicking a setting open 'the modal that pops up that explains that'; constitution XII (the project's ratified doctrine) makes a degree a calibration, not a choice between forms, so one standardized text explaining the turn explains every step of it, and seven texts would differ only by the number the card already shows. One case only (grain_drift) is so marked; adjudicated alone. Holds only while the one modal says what the shown value means (which way 'one way' and 'the other way' are, what 0 is).

Measured: row_line/sides/water feed only hamletgen/homesteads/rows.py (the linear form) and are recorded on nucleated Inashiro; farm_water_drawn is null on both linear maps; copse_clumps appears only on the three nucleated maps though copse_siting is recorded on all five; dike_crop, leftover, fry_form and pond_layout are forced to defaults off the dike-pond archetype (plan.py:471, 531-533). Each gate removes nothing a map draws. test_a_choice_of_one_settlement_form_is_not_listed_on_another enforces it.

decisions.summary: Per-settlement rolls that are not a choice of form - geometry, a degree, a share, a count - named in not_choices with why, and not listed on the card
decisions.why: New in the amendment; adjudicated per class. FR-009 defines the choices as 'each knob's value, and the per-map facts now in ### Features', and the project's ratified doctrine (constitution XII, CLAUDE.md: 'A degree along a continuum is calibrated liberty; a choice between distinct forms is a knob') is what makes an unregistered roll of a FORM a knob - the basis of round 1's ruling. The same doctrine says a degree is not one. Geometry (down_deg, water_flow, brook_side, grove_flank - a mirror pair, inert under the pool's NW wind): the map's orientation, drawn on the map, with no per-value explanation to open. Degrees and shares (fan_aspect, head_lead, persimmon_front, privy_seats, farm_fixtures): calibrated liberty, unregistered; the registered degree grain_drift stays on the card (D10-degree). Counts (woodland_patches) and retirement_share/retirement_house: the latter is ON the card as the count fact, so nothing is dropped. cluster_aspect_drawn is a measurement, not a roll. None guts the purpose: no feature modal carries per-map text for any of them, and none is a choice between forms.

Refusing at import is the established form for every other About-form error (Label:, old prose tags). No reach beyond the request.

decisions.summary: LINKS judged against 'the drawing pages the modal and its KIND rest on'; the bundle carries CANDIDATE drawing pages beyond Drawing: - (a) the sibling of each Entry question and (b) any drawing page the modal listed at the merge base (scripts/_modal_bundle.py drawing_candidates)
decisions.why: Round 3's required change, applied and confirmed in round 4. scripts/_modal_owed.py modals_at gains about_only (default True) and passes it to modals_in; scripts/_modal_bundle.py drawing_candidates now reads the base with modals_at(root, base, about_only=False), so an old-form docstring at the merge base is read and every .drawing.html under its Entry: (or Drawing:) becomes a candidate - leg (b) is live for the conversion case FR-012 makes universal. Both legs now reach what the decision states: (a) the sibling drawing page of each Entry question, (b) any drawing page the base listed in either form. test_a_drawing_page_the_old_form_listed_at_the_base_is_a_candidate_after_the_conversion isolates leg (b): the base is an old-form Farmhouse listing 0038-yards.drawing.html, the head cites only 0029 (whose drawing page does not exist in the fixture tree) with no Drawing:, so the candidate can come from the base read alone, and with about_only=True it would be skipped. Re-run in round 4: make test-file green, 10,989 passed. LINKS is judged against the drawing pages the modal and its KIND rest on (FR-014, SC-008, the GM: 'in cases where no such sections exist we would omit the tab'). No narrowing remains.
